mapper.insert: INSERT INTO seal.admin_user ( admin_user_id, login_id, display_name, organization_unit_id, password_hash, account_status, must_change_password ) VALUES ( #{admin.adminUserId}, #{admin.loginId}, #{admin.displayName}, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', #{admin.passwordHash}, 'ACTIVE', #{admin.mustChangePassword} )
INSERT INTO seal.user_role (admin_user_id, role_id, assigned_by) SELECT #{admin.adminUserId}, role_id, #{admin.adminUserId} FROM seal.admin_role WHERE role_code = 'SYSTEM_ADMIN' AND active = TRUE

INSERT INTO seal.user_scope ( user_scope_id, admin_user_id, scope_type, scope_target_id, include_descendants, assigned_by ) VALUES ( #{admin.userScopeId}, #{admin.adminUserId}, 'ORGANIZATION', '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', TRUE, #{admin.adminUserId} )
